rows.selection_reason: The existing evidence is empty, so the first experiment should establish a baseline by testing a well-balanced multimodal configuration. This experiment tests a standard multimodal setup with scgpt (RNA) and imagenet_vit_l (image) encoders, avgpool aggregation, and concat fusion. It clarifies the effectiveness of these components and sets a reference point for comparing other configurations.

The existing evidence shows that using avgpool aggregation with concat fusion achieves 51.76% accuracy. This experiment tests replacing avgpool with transformer aggregation, which could better capture complex interactions in multimodal data. It clarifies whether transformer aggregation improves performance, balancing exploitation of current multimodal setup with exploration of advanced aggregation methods.

The existing evidence shows that multimodal models with scgpt RNA encoder and concat fusion perform better than transformer aggregation. This experiment tests using resnet50 image encoder (vs imagenet_vit_l) and weighted fusion (vs concat) while keeping scgpt RNA encoder, which could clarify if image encoder or fusion method is the key factor. It balances exploration of critical design choices with building on the current top-performing RNA encoder.

Existing evidence shows config_001 (avgpool, concat) achieves the highest accuracy so far. This experiment tests changing fusion from concat to weighted while keeping RNA/image encoders and aggregation the same, clarifying if fusion method impacts performance. It balances exploitation of current top-performing components with exploration of critical design choices.

The existing evidence shows config_049 (0.542 accuracy) is the best so far using scgpt RNA, imagenet_vit_l image, avgpool aggregation, and weighted fusion. This experiment tests replacing avgpool with transformer aggregation while keeping other components the same, to determine if this change could further improve accuracy. It directly builds on the current best configuration, balancing exploitation of promising components with exploration of aggregation methods.

The existing evidence shows config_049 (multimodal, multiprofile, scgpt, imagenet_vit_l, avgpool, weighted) achieves the highest accuracy (0.542). This experiment tests using transformer aggregation with weighted fusion (same image encoder and RNA encoder as config_049) to explore if transformer aggregation could further improve performance. It clarifies whether the aggregation method's choice is critical, balancing exploitation of current best practices with exploration of alternative architectures.

The existing evidence shows config_008 (scvi_n200 + imagenet_vit_l) achieves the highest accuracy so far (0.725). This experiment tests whether using resnet50 as the image encoder (instead of imagenet_vit_l) with the same scvi_n200 RNA encoder, transformer aggregation, and weighted fusion could improve performance. It clarifies whether the image encoder choice is critical for further gains, leveraging the strong foundation of config_008 while exploring a key design choice.

The existing evidence shows that configurations using scvi_n200 RNA encoder (config_008, 0.725 accuracy; config_013, 0.713 accuracy) outperform others. This experiment tests scvi_n200 with resnet50 image encoder (not yet paired with scvi_n200) and avgpool aggregation (which hasn't been tested with this RNA/image pair). It clarifies whether resnet50 with avgpool could match or exceed the performance of imagenet_vit_l with transformer aggregation. This balances exploitation of scvi_n200's strength with exploration of new image encoder-aggregation combinations.

The existing evidence shows that models using scvi_n200 RNA encoder and transformer aggregation achieve high accuracy (e.g., config_008: 0.725). This experiment tests a similar setup with concat fusion instead of weighted fusion, clarifying whether fusion method impacts performance. It's the best use of the final experiment to explore a critical design choice with high potential for improvement.

Existing evidence shows that configurations using scvi_n200 RNA encoder with transformer aggregation and weighted fusion (e.g., config_008: 0.724989 accuracy) perform best. This experiment tests scvi_n200 with resnet50 image encoder, avgpool aggregation, and concat fusion, which could clarify if changing the image encoder and aggregation/fusion methods improves performance. It balances exploitation of scvi_n200's strength with exploration of alternative image encoders.
